title: Derived principal quotient tensor is the scalar multiplication cone
statement: Let f:R→A be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings, with kernel tR, where multiplication by t is injective on R. For every unbounded R-module cochain complex C, let L be the chosen second-factor mixed derived tensor with the regular A-module in degree zero. After restriction along f, L(QC) is isomorphic to Q(Cone(t·id_C)). The source and target localization Hom universes may be different.

proof.text: Choose an ordinary K-flat resolution P→C. Universal uniqueness compares the chosen second-factor derived family with the pointwise mixed derived tensor; its counit computes the result on P.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change; principal quotient specialization of the original item proof

proof.text: Restriction compares mixed total tensor with ordinary tensor and commutes with the single coefficient complex. The K-flat tensor-single comparison identifies the result with QP tensor the restricted A[0]; transport QP≅QC.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change; principal quotient specialization of the original item proof

proof.text: The hypotheses give the short exact sequence R --t→ R --f→ Res A. Its scalar cone maps quasi-isomorphically to Res A[0]. The cone is K-flat because it is the two-term free complex. The K-flat counit, tensor mapping-cone isomorphism and this quasi-isomorphism identify the tensor with Cone(t·id_C). All constructions are made in the actual localization universes.

theorem principalDerivedTensorCone {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wR} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (f : R →+* A) (t : R) (ht : Function.Injective (fun x : R ↦ t * x))
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hk : ∀ x : R, f x = 0 ↔ ∃ y : R, t * y = x)
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) :
    let N := (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      (ModuleCat.of A A)
    let L := ((exists_derivedTensor_second_factor_functor f).2.choose).obj N
    Nonempty (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars f).mapDerivedCategory).obj
      (L.obj (Q.obj C)) ≅ Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone (t • 𝟙 C)))
